name: Ghost be Ambitious!
original_name: ゴーストbeアンビシャス!
source:
I'm an ordinary guy. 
That is, I was until I got run over and became a ghost. 
I discovered the ability to jump into Ayana Shinto's body. 
Using this power, I began my campus haunt!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120656.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是一个普通人。
也就是说，我一直是这样，直到我被碾过，变成了鬼魂。
我发现了跳入绫奈神道身体的能力。
借助这股力量，我开始了我的校园出没！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120656.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
